boundaries.csharp: dotnet-guarded-call-v1; includes trusted entry dispatch/guard notification, excludes map clone

limitations: one Windows machine; not capacity or latency guarantees
runtime/compiler and guard changes are included, so differences cannot be attributed solely to removing one IPC hop
end-to-end round-trip is comparable; execution/overhead decomposition changes with the JS timing boundary
residual overhead includes preparation, protocol checks, serialization, scheduling and transport
synthetic identical BFS and independent streams; real start-slot swaps verified separately in CSharpGameChecks
full per-call reports are generated under artifacts by the harness; summaries and first/slowest samples retained here
